profile.headline: Senior Software Developer, Native Applications at Tuple
profile.summary: Experienced Senior Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the computer software industry. Strong engineering professional skilled in OS X, iOS, C++ Objective-C, Swift, Mobile Applications, Software Design, and Software Development.

positions.title: Software Engineer IV
positions.description:
Designed and implemented a system to allow an iPad application to work with multi-gigabyte 3d geometric datasets through a shared product suite backend.
Worked throughout a cross-platform codebase (iOS/Windows/macOS/linux) to troubleshoot issues, pay down technical debt, and optimize performance.
